title: Attempted Armed Robbery At The Home Of Mr. A. Corrit

page_data.en:
Misc. No. 818/40. B'well
Rec. 17, 40.

1.

ATTEMPTED ARMED ROBBERY AT THE HOME OF MR.
A. CORRIT, 230 ROCKHILL AVENUE, D.O.L.

At 8.25 p.m. 17-1'-40, a telephone call was
received at this station from Mr. A. Corrit, Danish,
Architect, 230 Rockhill Avenue, reporting that a gang
of men were in the garden, and firing shots at his
brother Mr. N. . Ivanoff.

A party under S.I. Kourjansky at once turned out,
and on arrival at the scene, found that a number of
S.C.G.P.B. officers had taken up positions on the
roadway outside the house.

Because of the deployment of S.C.G.P.B. Officers
on the roadway, the S.M.Police party was unable to gain
entry to the house.

S.I. Kourjansky observed a person lying on the
footpath close to the fence of 200 Rockhill Avenue
(the home of Mr. C.S. Franklin), and from members of the
S.C.G.P.B. party, learned that it was one of their men
who had been wounded by a shot.

Officer i/c B.W. visited the scene, and after
establishing contact with the S.C.G.P.B. Party, entry
into the house was effected.

From Mr. A. Corrit, members of his household, and
guests, the following was learned:-
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 818/40。静安寺捕房
1940年12月17日收文。

1.

洛克希尔路（Rockhill Avenue）230号 A. Corrit 先生寓所发生持械抢劫未遂案。

1940年1月17日晚8时25分，本捕房接到丹麦籍建筑师、居住于洛克希尔路230号的 A. Corrit 先生电话报案，称有一伙人闯入花园，并向其兄弟 N. Ivanoff 先生开枪射击。

由警佐 Kourjansky 率领的一队警员立即出动，抵达现场后发现，数名上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.C.G.P.B.）警员已在该宅邸外的道路上占据位置。

由于上海公共租界工部局警务处警员在道路上的部署，上海公共租界工部局警察（S.M.Police）小队无法进入屋内。

警佐 Kourjansky 观察到一人躺在洛克希尔路200号（C.S. Franklin 先生寓所）围栏附近的人行道上，并从上海公共租界工部局警务处小队成员处获悉，那是他们的一名人员中弹受伤。

“B”区巡官负责人视察了现场，在与上海公共租界工部局警务处小队建立联系后，得以进入屋内。

从 A. Corrit 先生、其家属及客人处获悉以下情况：

page_data.en:
Misc. No. 318/40.

1/-.

At about 8 p.m. 17-12-40, Miss J. Ivanoff, nurse
employed by Mr. Corrit, heard the sound of footsteps
in the apartment above. (This is a separate part of the
house, and at present unoccupied). Miss Ivanoff
informed her mistress of this, and also told Mr.Corrit.
Mrs. Corrit says, when informed of this, and not
knowing quite what to do, she rang up her brother Mr.
H.P. Ivanoff, 193/4 Pte. Tenant De La Tour. Y.C., and
asked him to come over to the house because they were
having trouble. About 20 minutes after this, Mrs.
Corrit concluded, she heard the sound of several shots
fired, and her brother Mr. H.P. Ivanoff came into the
house, saying he had been fired upon as he came in.
Mr. Ivanoff, when he came in, suggested the Police
should be notified, and Mr. Corrit put a call through
to this station.
Mr. Ivanoff informed D.S. Greenfield:-
At a few minutes after 8 p.m. 17-12-40, he received
a telephone call from his sister, stating there was
trouble at the house. He at once, together with his
friend Mr. F. Neugebaur, got into a car and drove to
the house. As he went into the front gate from the
roadway, a shot was suddenly fired at him from close
range in the garden. He did not see any person, and
then, "in self protection", fired one shot into the air
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 318/40。

1/-.

1940年12月17日晚8时许，Corrit 先生雇用的护士 J. Ivanoff 小姐听到楼上公寓传来脚步声。（这是房屋的一个独立部分，目前无人居住）。Ivanoff 小姐将此情况告知女主人，并告诉了 Corrit 先生。Corrit 夫人称，得知此事后，因不知如何是好，她致电其兄弟 H.P. Ivanoff 先生（地址：德拉图尔私人租户公寓 193/4 号，Y.C.），请他到家里来，因为他们遇到了麻烦。Corrit 夫人推断，约20分钟后，她听到几声枪响，随后其兄弟 H.P. Ivanoff 先生进入屋内，称他在进门时遭到射击。
Ivanoff 先生进屋后建议报警，Corrit 先生随即致电本捕房。
Ivanoff 先生向侦探副督察 Greenfield 陈述如下：
1940年12月17日晚8点刚过，他接到姐姐的电话，称家中出事。他立即与朋友 F. Neugebaur 先生一同驾车前往该宅邸。当他从道路进入前门时，花园内突然有人近距离向他开枪。他未看见任何人，随后出于“自卫”，用手枪向空中开了一枪。

page_data.en:
Misc. No. 818/40.
1/3.

from his own private pistol. He ran out of the gate
way on to the road again, and called two S.S.O. P.B.
officers whom he had seen nearby when he came in. As
he went back through the gateway, four or five shots
were fired at him from various parts of the garden.
After this, he made his way across the garden into
the house.

Meanwhile, Mr. V. Neugebauer says he took cover
in the grass just inside the gateway, and saw one
person, probably a Chinese, limp across the roadway
from the direction of the garden wall, and disappear
across fields on the other side of the road.

Mr. Corrit says he can give no reason for the
affair. Two or three nights previous an attempt was
made to break into the servants' quarters, but he did
not notify the Police (Mr. Corrit's telephone number
is 28043, but for some reason it is not listed in the
directory. On a previous occasion, it will be
remembered, Mr. Corrit was arrested by Japanese
authorities).

The private watchman on the front gate says no
strangers came in this way. The house and its
grounds are surrounded by a high wall. It would seem
probable that the gang climbed the wall from the rear
of the house. How they gained entry to the apartment
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 818/40。
1/3.

他从自己的私人手枪中射出这一发子弹。他跑出大门回到路上，呼救两名他在进来时看到在附近的上海特别市警察局（S.S.O. P.B.）警员。当他再次穿过大门返回时，花园的不同方向又向他开了四五枪。此后，他穿过花园进入屋内。

与此同时，V. Neugebauer 先生称，他在大门内侧的草丛中隐蔽，看见一个人（可能是中国人）一瘸一拐地从花园墙方向穿过马路，消失在马路另一侧的田野中。

Corrit 先生表示，他无法说明此事的起因。两三个晚上前，曾有人试图闯入仆人宿舍，但他并未报警（Corrit 先生的电话号码是 28043，但出于某种原因未在电话簿中列出。记得在此前的一次事件中，Corrit 先生曾被日本当局逮捕）。

前门的私人看守称没有陌生人从此处进入。房屋及其庭院由高墙环绕。这伙匪徒似乎很可能是从房屋后方翻墙而入。至于他们如何进入楼顶的公寓，

page_data.en:
Misc. No. 813/40.
1/4.

at the top of the house, cannot at present be ascertained. They may have had keys to the servants' entrance.
When they got into the top apartment, it appears that the gang opened a verandah window, and prepared to climb down into Mr. Corrits' part of the house.
A search of the grounds was made, but without result.
About 30 members of the S.C.G.P.B. and several Japanese Gendarmerie attended, and questioned the inmates.
Mr. and Mrs. C.H. Duff of the S.M.C./P.W.D. arrived at the house for dinner at the time shots were being fired.
If the injured S.C.G. Official was wounded at the spot where he was seen lying, it would be a shot from the roadway which hit him. It would be impossible for a person inside to fire at him because of the high wall.
The injured S.C.G.P.B. official was removed to the Red Cross Hospital, and detained, suffering from "G.S.W. chest, etc. condition critical". Several of his colleagues remained at the bed side.
It is believed that members of the S.C.G.P.B. fired shots at the scene.
D.S. Greenfield requested Mr. Ivanoff to hand over
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 813/40。
1/4.

目前尚无法查明。他们可能有仆人入口的钥匙。
当他们进入顶层公寓后，这伙人似乎打开了一扇阳台窗户，准备爬下进入 Corrit 先生居住的房屋部分。
对庭院进行了搜查，但无结果。
约30名上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.C.G.P.B.）人员和几名日本宪兵到场，并对屋内人员进行了讯问。
公共工务局（P.W.D.）的 C.H. Duff 夫妇当时正到该宅邸共进晚餐，枪声正是在此时响起。
如果受伤的上海公共租界工部局官员是在被发现躺卧的地方受伤，那么击中他的子弹应来自道路方向。由于高墙的阻隔，屋内的人不可能向他射击。
受伤的上海公共租界工部局官员被送往红十字会医院，留院治疗，伤情为“胸部枪伤等，情况危急”。他的几名同事留在病床旁守候。
据信，上海公共租界工部局警务处人员在现场开了枪。
侦探副督察 Greenfield 要求 Ivanoff 先生交出

page_data.en:
Misc. No. 318/40.

1/5.

his pistol ( No. 190276, Colt .45 auto and 5 rounds,
licenced C.M.F.). This will be forwarded for
examination.
Sen. Det. 1/o and D.D.J."B" Div. informed.
Circulated.

1.

At 1.20 a.m. 24-10-39 a telephone message was
received from Mr. F. . SCHLOBOHM, American, residing
house no. 567 Hungjao Road, S.S.B. (Municipal Tax-payer),
reporting that during his absence his house had been
burgled by a gang of half Chinese one of whom was armed
with a pistol, who had stolen the following weapons:-

(1) One Mauser pistol fitted with a new pattern
    double magazine in a wooden holster butt.
(2) Two Mauser pistols, long barrel type.
(3) Two Mauser pistols, short barrel type.
(4) One Bergman .32 auto pistol.
(5) One Demon .32 auto pistol.
(6) Two .32 auto pistols, maker's name unknown.
(7) One Belgium made .25 auto pistol.

together with one gent's overcoat, one gent's silver
wrist watch and one silver cigarette case, the latter
described articles he estimated the value to be
approximately $200.00.

Upon receipt of this report, Mr. Tabrum, A/D.D.J.
"B", was communicated with, and he suggested that Mr.
Schlobohm attend the Station as soon as possible, further
any articles touched by the gang likely to reveal finger
prints, should be preserved so that investigation could
be conducted later.

This information was conveyed to Mr. Schlobohm by
telephone, and he agreed to call at the Station.

（左侧手写批注：None of these weapons are registered at the Arms & Ammunition Section.）
（左侧下方另有潦草签名及数字标记）

                       1939年10月24日

1.

〔此处转录不清〕

1939年10月24日凌晨1时20分，接到居住于虹桥路567号（越界筑路区）的美国市民（市政纳税人）F. SCHLOBOHM 先生的电话留言，报告在其外出期间，其住宅遭一伙半华半洋匪徒入室盗窃，其中一人持有手枪，窃走以下武器：-

(1) 一支毛瑟手枪，配有新型双弹匣，装在木质枪套底把中。
(2) 两支长管型毛瑟手枪。
(3) 两支短管型毛瑟手枪。
(4) 一支伯格曼（Bergman）.32 口径自动手枪。
(5) 一支 Demon .32 口径自动手枪。
(6) 两支 .32 口径自动手枪，制造商名称不详。
(7) 一支比利时制造的 .25 口径自动手枪。

以及一件男式大衣、一块男式银质腕表和一个银质烟盒，据他估计，上述物品价值约为 200.00 美元。

收到此报告后，已与“B”区代理副侦探长 Tabrum 先生联系，他建议 Schlobohm 先生尽快前往捕房，此外，凡被匪徒触碰过、可能留有指纹的物品均应保留，以便日后进行调查。

此信息已通过电话传达给 Schlobohm 先生，他同意前来捕房。

（左侧手写批注：这些武器均未在枪械弹药科登记。）
（左侧下方另有潦草签名及数字标记）

Misc. 0.583/39 (BW)

1 (Sheet 2)

At 7.10 a.m. Mr. Schlobohm attended, and
offered the following:-

At about 12.30 p.m. 24-10-39 he received a tele-
phone message from his house boy at his place of
employment, C.C.O. to the effect that his house had
been visited by a gang of robbers.

Upon receipt of this message he immediately proceed-
ed home and upon arrival ascertained the following:-

At about 11.00 p.m. 24-10-39, a gang, exact number
unknown, entered the grounds by forcing open the front
bamboo fence gate which abutts the roadway.

Four of the gang, one of whom was armed with a
pistol, by breaking one of the lower panes of a dining
room French Window, gained entrance, after releasing
the inside window bolt.

His house boy upon hearing the commotion, immediate-
ly barricaded himself in the bedroom situated on the
ground floor.

During the meantime, the remainder of the gang
went into the gardener's quarters situated at the rear
of the house, and after intimidating him, obtained two
ladders from the store house, which they brought into
the house.

One ladder was placed in the pantry, and one ladder
was placed in the sitting, the reason for this was
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 0.583/39 (BW)

1 (第2页)

上午7时10分，Schlobohm 先生到达，并提供以下情况：

1939年10月24日中午12时30分左右，他在工作地点（中国公交公司，C.C.O.）接到家童的电话，称家中遭一伙劫匪光顾。

收到此消息后，他立即回家，抵达后查明以下情况：

1939年10月24日晚11时左右，一伙人数不明的匪徒强行打开紧邻道路的竹篱笆前门，进入庭院。

匪徒中的四人（其中一人持有手枪）打碎餐厅法式落地窗的一块下部玻璃，松开内部窗栓后进入屋内。

他的家童听到骚动声后，立即将自己反锁在一楼的一间卧室内。

在此期间，其余匪徒进入位于房屋后部的园丁宿舍，在恐吓园丁后，从储藏室取得两架梯子，并将其搬入屋内。

一架梯子放在食品储藏室，另一架放在客厅，这样做的原因是

page_data.en:
Misc. 5.388/39 (BW)
1 (Sheet 3)

〔此处转录不清〕 which is a
single storey bungalow .

〔此处转录不清〕 round, removed the
pistol from the pantry attic, where same were stored.

Whilst the gang were decamping with the loot, after
one of the miscreants had stolen the overcoat, watch and
cigarette case, which had been left in the dining room,
his boy opened fire through the bedroom window with his
.45 automatic colt, to which one of the gang replied by
firing a number of shots from his pistol, which did not
take effect. Following this, the gang decamped via the
point of entry.

Mr. Schlobohm stated, that before he arrived home,
his houseboy together with the gardener whilst straight-
ening the house, had freely touched all vantage points
likely to bear finger prints. A search, however,
revealed two bullets and two, expended cartridge cases
which had been fired from the robbers pistol. These
have been forwarded to the Arms Identification Section
for examination.

Questioned by D.S. Till, Mr. Schlobohm stated that
the only person whom he could connect with the robbery
who had actual knowledge of the weapons apart from his
present household staff, was an amah who left his
employ about 8 months ago, and is now believed to be
residing in the vicinity.
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 5.388/39 (BW)
1 (第3页)

〔此处转录不清〕这是一栋单层平房。

〔此处转录不清〕周围，从食品储藏室的阁楼取走了存放于此的手枪。

当匪徒携带赃物逃离时，其中一名罪犯偷走了留在餐厅的大衣、手表和烟盒，此时他的家童透过卧室窗户用 .45 口径柯尔特自动手枪开火，一名匪徒用手枪回射数枪，但未击中。随后，匪徒沿进入点逃离。

Schlobohm 先生称，在他回家之前，他的家童和园丁在整理房屋时，随意触摸了所有可能留有指纹的关键位置。然而，搜查发现了两颗子弹和两个由劫匪手枪射出的空弹壳。这些物证已送交枪械识别科进行检验。

经侦探副督察 Till 讯问，Schlobohm 先生表示，除了目前的家政人员外，他唯一能联想到与抢劫案有关且确实知晓武器下落的人，是一名约8个月前离职的女佣（amah），据信目前仍居住在附近。

OCT 24 1939

Bandits Attack Hungjao
American Home

Bullets Fired
At Houseboy

Bus Company Engineer
F. W. Schlobohm
Victimized

Hungjao bandits last night robbed the home of Mr. and Mrs. F. W. Schlobohm of property believed to be valued at over $1000. firing shots at the house boy who attempted to put in a telephone call for aid. The boy himself fired two shots from a pistol, but had to beat a hasty retreat after the gun jammed.

The robbery took place at 567 Hungjao Road, almost opposite the polo field, from 11.45 p.m. to 12.30 a.m., a gang of about eight being involved. Four of them entered the house and four remained outside, it being at the latter that the houseboy shot.

Neither Mr. nor Mrs. Schlobohm were at home at the time. Mr. Schlobohm, American motor engineer, is in charge of the night shift at the China General Omnibus Company and so was on duty, while Mrs. Schlobohm was staying with friends in Shanghai. The houseboy finally managed to phone his master after the robbery was over, and it was not until shortly after 1 a.m. that Mr. Schlobohm reached his home.

The robbers made the gardener living at the house go to the garage and fetch a ladder which was kept there, so that they could get to the loft where various items of property were stored. The gardener was threatened at pistol point. Later on several shots were fired into the house, lodging in walls and doors.

The home of Mr. and Mrs. W. R. McBain, a quarter of a mile further along Hungjao Road, was visited by burglars only three weeks ago, when silverware and cutlery was taken.

（批：Xu 10）

8930
1939年10月25日
1939年10月24日

匪徒袭击虹桥
美籍人士寓所

向家童
开枪

巴士公司工程师
F. W. Schlobohm
受害

昨晚，虹桥路匪徒抢劫了 F. W. Schlobohm 夫妇的寓所，财产损失估计超过1000美元，并向试图打电话求救的家童开枪。家童本人用手枪还击两枪，但在枪支卡壳后被迫匆忙撤退。

抢劫发生在虹桥路567号，几乎正对着跑马厅马球场，时间从晚上11时45分至凌晨12时30分，涉及约八人的团伙。其中四人进入屋内，四人留在外面，家童正是向外面的匪徒开枪。

案发时 Schlobohm 夫妇均不在家。Schlobohm 先生是美国汽车工程师，负责中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）的夜班工作，因此正在值班，而 Schlobohm 夫人则在上海的朋友家借宿。抢劫结束后，家童终于设法打通了主人的电话，Schlobohm 先生直到凌晨1点后不久才回到家。

劫匪迫使住在屋内的园丁去车库取来存放在那里的一架梯子，以便他们进入存放各种物品的阁楼。园丁在枪口威胁下照办。随后，数发子弹射入屋内，嵌入墙壁和门中。

沿虹桥路再向前四分之一英里处的 W. R. McBain 夫妇寓所，仅在两周前也曾遭窃贼光顾，银器和餐具被盗。

（批注：Xu 10）

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

NOV 10 1939

City Police Ignore
Lady's Appeal

Briton's Bag is Snatched
In Yu Yuen Road But No
Help is Extended

Two Chinese members of the
"Special Municipality" police in uni-
form are said to have ignored the
pleas of a British lady for assistance
on Friday evening after her hand-
bag had been snatched by a Chinese
in Yu Yuen Road west of Edinburgh
Road.

The lady had just alighted from a
bus at 8 o'clock and was walking
towards the lane in which she lives
when a Chinese walked up from
behind and snatched her bag from
under her arm. The thief started
running, making for an alleyway
leading off Yu Yuen Road.

The victim of the robbery imme-
diately made an alarm and pursued
the snatcher. She addressed herself
to two Chinese members of the
"Special Municipality" police pres-
ent, in uniform and armed, near
the scene of the crime. She reports
that neither man made the slightest
effort to help and that they did not
even acknowledge the fact that she
was appealing to them.

Consequently the two robbers had
no difficulty in making good their
escape by way of an alleyway lead-
ing from the south side of Yu Yuen
Road into "Special Municipality"
territory. The culprits had not been
arrested yesterday.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，

1939年11月10日

市警察无视
女士求助

英国女士手提包在
愚园路被抢但无人
施以援手

据称，周五傍晚，一名英国女士在爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）以西的愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）被一名中国人抢走手提包后，向两名身穿制服的“特别市”警察求助，但遭到无视。

该女士于8点钟刚下公交车，正走向她居住的弄堂时，一名中国人从背后走近，从她臂下抢走了手提包。窃贼开始奔跑，朝一条从愚园路岔出的小巷逃去。

抢劫案的受害者立即发出警报并追赶抢夺者。她向案发地点附近在场的两名身穿制服、携带武器的“特别市”中国警员求助。她报告说，这两人未做任何努力提供帮助，甚至对她向他们求助的事实置之不理。

因此，两名劫匪毫不费力地通过一条从愚园路南侧通向“特别市”辖区的小巷成功逃脱。截至昨日，罪犯尚未被捕。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
OCT 8 1939

Foreign Women Robbed
Of Rings In Daylight
Hold-Up On Yu Yuen Rd.

One Gangster Points Pistol At Three Women As
Accomplice Pulls Off Rings And Watch;
Victims Too Scared To Raise An Alarm

GUNMEN GETTING BOLDER AS ATTACKS
ON FOREIGN WOMEN INCREASE

Getting bolder every day and taking advantage of the
opportunity to escape into Chinese-controlled territory, where
they are safe from pursuit by officers of the Shanghai Municipal
Police, activities of armed gangsters have increased in the
Western Outside areas of late, and, for the second time in
three days, foreign women were victimized in broad daylight
yesterday, on Yu Yuen Road.

The victims yesterday were Mrs. E. H. Ezekiel, Miss Ezekiel
and Mrs. E. Jacob, all residing at House 2, Lane 520, Yu Yuen
Road. They were held-up by two desperadoes, only one of
whom produced a pistol, and were robbed of five diamond rings
and a wrist watch valued at $2,422. The robbery happened so
quickly and in front of several passersby, that when the robbers
escaped the women were still too frightened to run after them
or to raise an alarm.

Yesterday's daring hold-up, which
was staged at about 11.45 a.m., took
place not far from the spot where
Mrs. F. Bridges, British, was vic-
timized on Thursday morning, also
by two men, one of whom was
armed, who robbed her of a hand-
bag containing $20 and other arti-
cles. Yesterday the robbers con-
centrated their attention on pulling
the rings off the fingers of Mrs.
Ezekiel and Mrs. Jacob and taking
a wrist watch from Miss Ezekiel.
Although the women were carrying
handbags, the robbers made no
attempt to steal them.

"Were Scared"

Upon being interviewed by a re-
presentative of "The Shanghai Sun-
day Times" yesterday, Mrs. Ezekiel
related that she, together with her
daughter and Mrs. Jacob, were
walking down Yu Yuen Road to-
wards Tifeng Road, when suddenly
two Chinese appeared in front of
them. "One of them," she continu-
ed, "pointed a pistol at us. We
were all frightened and did not
know what to do. The other man
then took hold of my hand and
pulled three rings off my fingers.
He then pulled two rings off Mrs.
Jacob's fingers. The man then
turned his attention to my daughter,
snatched off her wrist watch, and
then the men ran off towards
Edinburgh Road."

Mrs. Ezekiel then related that
she and her companions were too
scared to give chase or even raise
an alarm. "We just stood and
looked for a policeman," she re-
lated. Finally, when a policeman
was found the robbers had disap-
peared down an alley off Yu Yuen
Road, running into Chinese terri-
tory.

Later the women proceeded to
the Bubbling Well Police Station
and reported the robbery, giving
a description of their rings and
the watch.

（批：Yie C 4/10）
page_data.zh:
《上海泰晤士报》
1939年10月8日

外国妇女在光天化日之下
于愚园路遭持械抢劫
戒指被夺

一名歹徒用枪指着三名妇女，同伙扯下戒指和手表；
受害者因恐惧不敢呼救

随着针对外国妇女的袭击增加，持枪歹徒愈发大胆

日益大胆并利用逃入华人控制区的机会——在那里他们免受上海公共租界工部局警务处警员的追捕——近期，武装歹徒在西区界外地区的活动有所增加，且在三天内第二次有外国妇女在光天化日之下于愚园路成为受害者。

昨天的受害者是E. H. Ezekiel夫人、Ezekiel小姐和E. Jacob夫人，均居住在愚园路520弄2号。她们遭到两名亡命之徒的拦截，其中仅一人亮出手枪，被抢走五枚钻戒和一只价值2,422美元的手表。抢劫发生得如此迅速，且发生在几名路人面前，以至于当劫匪逃跑时，这些妇女仍因恐惧而不敢追赶或呼救。

昨天这起大胆的持械抢劫案发生在上午11点45分左右，地点离F. Bridges夫人（英国人）周四早上受害的地方不远，当时也是两名男子，其中一人持有武器，抢走了她装有20美元和其他物品的手提包。昨天，劫匪专注于从Ezekiel夫人和Jacob夫人的手指上扯下戒指，并从Ezekiel小姐手上抢走一只手表。虽然这些妇女都带着手提包，但劫匪并未试图偷窃。

“感到害怕”

Ezekiel夫人昨天在接受《上海星期泰晤士报》代表采访时叙述道，她与女儿及Jacob夫人正沿着愚园路向蒂丰路（Tifeng Road，音译）方向行走时，突然两名中国人出现在她们面前。“其中一人，”她继续说道，“用枪指着我们。我们都吓坏了，不知所措。另一人随后抓住我的手，从我的手指上扯下三枚戒指。接着他从Jacob夫人的手指上扯下两枚戒指。随后那人将注意力转向我女儿，抢走了她的手表，然后两人朝爱丁堡路方向逃跑了。”

Ezekiel夫人随后表示，她和同伴们因过于害怕而不敢追赶，甚至不敢呼救。“我们就站在那里寻找警察，”她叙述道。最后，当找到一名警察时，劫匪已消失在愚园路的一条小巷中，跑进了华人辖区。

随后，这些妇女前往静安寺警察局报案，并提供了她们的戒指和手表的描述。

（批注：Yie C 4/10）

page_data.en:
$3,650 In Notes
Another large haul was obtained by two other armed desperadoes yesterday morning. The two armed men lay in wait for a shop assistant in Lane 41, Carter Road, at 9.45 a.m., just as he was proceeding to the bank to deposit some money, and robbed him of a parcel containing $3,650.
In all, armed gangsters got away with loot valued at over $6,000 yesterday, morning.
Police Thanked
Mrs. A. D. Agrault, wife of an American naval officer, who had her bag snatched on Szechuen Road on Thursday morning, whilst she had over Ch.$1,600, U.S.$35, and other valuables in the bag, went to the Central Police Station yesterday to inquire whether anything was recovered and at the same time to thank the police officers for their co-operation.
Mrs. Agrault also expressed her thanks to a foreign gentleman, who assisted her and went with her to the police station on Thursday morning after her bag had been snatched,
page_data.zh:
3,650美元现钞
昨天上午，另外两名武装亡命之徒又获得了一大笔赃款。上午9点45分，这两名武装男子在卡特路（Carter Road，音译）41弄埋伏了一名店员，就在他前往银行存钱之际，抢走了他装有3,650美元的包裹。
总计，武装歹徒昨天上午携走的赃物价值超过6,000美元。
感谢警方
美国海军军官A. D. Agrault的夫人Agrault夫人，周四早上在四川路（Szechuen Road）被抢走手提包，当时包内有法币1,600余元、35美元及其他贵重物品，她昨天前往中央警察局询问是否追回任何物品，并同时感谢警方的合作。
Agrault夫人还向一位外国绅士表示感谢，该绅士在她手提包被抢后协助了她，并于周四早上陪她前往警察局，

page_data.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
OCT 8 1939

Armed Pair Again
Rob Ladies
Three Foreign Women
Lose Money and Gems
In Yu Yuen Road

Three foreign ladies, Mrs. J. H.
Ezekiel, her daughter, Miss R. Ezekiel,
and Mrs. D. Jacobs, were robbed
while walking in Yu Yuen Road near
Edinburgh Road at 11.40 a.m. yes-
terday by two Chinese bandits who
subsequently disappeared into "Spe-
cial Municipality" territory.
The audacious crime formed an
exact parallel to the robbing of Mrs.
F. S. Bridges, another resident of
Yu Yuen Road, at the very same
spot last Thursday morning. Again,
two Chinese one of whom displayed
an automatic pistol were responsible,
their descriptions tallying with those
of the pair who held up Mrs. Bridges.
Further, they used the same tactics
in tackling their prey for money and
jewellery, and they escaped in iden-
tical manner through the same alley-
way. The Settlement Police are
carefully watching the entrance to
this lane in order to prevent recur-
rences.
The three ladies, who reside in
Lane 520, Yu Yuen Road, were ac-
costed as they were outside 824 Yu
Yuen Road and were terrified when
one of the two robbers waved a
pistol at them. They were ordered
to hand over their finger-rings and
handbags, and promptly complied
with the demand. Altogether, the
bandits obtained loot worth $2,422,
consisting of money, rings and one
wrist-watch. The robbery was over
in remarkably short time and the two
men ran as fast as they could down
a narrow lane leading into non-Set-
tlement territory. They succeeded in
escaping.

Police Turn Out

An alarm was sounded a few min-
utes afterwards and brought a large
complement of detectives and uni-
formed men from the Bubbling Well
Police Station, but by the time the
police arrived the robbers were pre-
sumably well within the area under
"Special Municipality" jurisdiction.
A detailed account of the crime was
subsequently given by the victims
to detectives at the Bubbling Well
Station, who broadcast the descrip-
tions of the bandits.
Mrs. Bridges was robbed in similar
circumstances at the same place at
10.45 o'clock on Thursday morning,
when two men took her two finger-
rings and handbag containing money
and papers.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，
1939年10月8日

武装二人组再次
抢劫女士
三名外国妇女
在愚园路
损失钱财与珠宝

昨天上午11点40分，三名外国女士，J. H. Ezekiel夫人、她的女儿R. Ezekiel小姐和D. Jacobs夫人，在靠近爱丁堡路的愚园路行走时，被两名中国匪徒抢劫，随后匪徒消失于“特别市”辖区。

这起大胆的犯罪与上周四早上在同一地点抢劫另一位愚园路居民F. S. Bridges夫人的案件如出一辙。同样是两名中国人，其中一人展示了一把自动手枪，他们的体貌特征与拦截Bridges夫人的那两人相符。此外，他们使用了相同的手段来夺取猎物的钱财和珠宝，并通过同一条小巷以相同的方式逃脱。租界警察正严密监视该弄堂的入口，以防止此类事件再次发生。

这三位居住在愚园路520弄的女士，在愚园路824号外被搭讪，当两名劫匪中的一人向她们挥舞手枪时，她们惊恐万分。她们被命令交出戒指和手提包，并立即照办。总共，匪徒获得了价值2,422美元的赃物，包括现金、戒指和一只手表。抢劫在极短的时间内结束，两人尽可能快地跑进一条通往非租界辖区的狭窄弄堂。他们成功逃脱。

警察出动

几分钟后发出了警报，静安寺警察局的大量便衣侦探和制服警员出动，但当警察到达时，劫匪可能已深入“特别市”管辖区域。受害者随后向静安寺警察局的侦探详细陈述了案情，侦探们发布了匪徒的特征描述。
Bridges夫人在类似情况下于同一地点于周四上午10点45分被抢，当时两名男子拿走了她的两枚戒指以及装有现金和文件的手提包。

《字林西报》
1939年3月24日
编号

西区状况
遭严厉批评
西部（界外）协会年会通过决议要求采取行动

昨晚在怡和洋行有限公司（Jardine, Matheson & Co., Ltd.）的董事会会议室举行的西部（界外）协会第一次年会上，西区日益恶化的状况引发了尖锐批评。会议通过了一项决议，表达协会对该地区居民和业主面临的严重问题的关切，并请新一届委员会考虑提请工部局注意该地区的充分警务、卫生、防火及其他公共卫生和公共工程事项、对工厂的有效管控，以及协会在工部局为处理该地区问题而设立的任何委员会中的代表权问题。J. W. T. Brooke 先生（主席）主持会议。

主席在发言中说：然而，总体而言，我很遗憾……在处理过去一年的事件之前，我想先就西部（界外）协会的起源和目标说几句话。正如你们大多数人所意识到的那样，在构成上海的相对较小的区域内，存在着不少于四种不同类型的政府；实际上是五种，但我们可以暂时忽略那些目前不允许外国人居住的区域。（1）公共租界由居住在其内的纳税人选举产生的工部局控制；（2）法租界由其领事治理；（3）上述两个区域以外且位于铁路线以西的区域（其中包括虹桥）目前名义上受日本人控制；（4）而从租界边界以西至铁路，以及从罗别根路（Rockhill Avenue）至苏州河的区域，目前是一种类似无主地的状态。不过请注意，它位于上海由外国军队防卫的那部分区域内，但它缺乏任何中央控制；它没有明确的政府，最糟糕的是它没有发言权，没有投票权（尽管它向公共租界工部局缴纳捐税），没有纠正现有弊端的手段，也没有一个法人团体向征税者陈述其观点，而征税者无疑负有明确的道德义务，将其维持为一个健康、守法且适宜居住的区域。这个大型住宅区——其面积与西区相当——的特殊情况和地位，导致了西部（界外）协会的成立。

每况愈下
一年多以前，成立了一个小型委员会，随后召集了一次非投票纳税人的会议。一些人出席了会议，选举产生了常设委员会，而你们今天下午聚集在这里，正是为了听取他们第一年工作的成果。委员会的报告和账目声明已分发给所有成员，因此我现在没有必要向你们宣读。

一份涉及委员会部分工作的先前报告已于1938年8月17日分发给成员，从那份报告以及当前的报告中，你们可以看到，协会在许多情况下成功制止了个别滋扰行为，此处不再详述。

火灾风险
出现了大量工厂和作坊，虽然它们可能并不对健康构成实际危险，但在许多情况下极其令人反感，并造成非常难闻的气味。凯斯威克路（Keswick Road）沿线的蚕茧烘干作业就是一个例子。大量简陋且不卫生的建筑物拔地而起，毫无疑问，它们构成了严重的火灾隐患；正如你们大多数人所知，整个地区的火灾保险费已经增加了25%。供水不足以应对此类火灾，虽然有人向我们保证，尽管有需求，新的接水点并未获批，但用水量却大幅增加。然而，主干管并没有相应增加，一般用途的供水肯定不足。

赌场生意兴隆，各种罪恶活动公然进行，并受到不受工部局控制的人员的纵容。由于道路之间区域的卫生条件恶劣和过度拥挤，流行病爆发的危险很大。公共卫生部门为改善状况做了大量工作，但其资源不足，且无权采取真正必要的严厉措施。这些情况为协会成员所熟知，他们也认识到工部局面临的困难，因为工部局依赖于领事团和军事当局的积极支持。

page_data.en:
Much Accomplished

In spite, however, of this sad story
of deterioration, your committee, as
I mentioned in my opening remarks,
have accomplished much in the
suppression of abuses and even more
in the prevention of nuisances in the
shape of offensive factories and oc-
cupations. Constant observation and
immediate action are necessary to
obtain results and it is in the ob-
servation and reporting of nuisances
that your committee ask for the
wholehearted co-operation of the
members of the Association to enable
them to approach the offenders or the
authorities concerned.

I would lay stress on the fact that
this is an international Association
and that members can do much by
pressing for reforms through their
Consular representatives and Cham-
bers of Commerce. We hope and
believe that a time will soon arrive
when a representative body such as
our Association will exert a definite
and permanent influence in the gov-
ernment and control of the district
which it represents and be of valuable
assistance to the Council in its deal-
ings with other authorities.

As regards the accounts you will
see that last year we collected $1,240
in subscriptions and that have now a
balance of $265.79 in hand. In con-
clusion the Chairman proposed that
the report of the committee and the
accounts for the financial year ending
February 28, 1939 be adopted. This
was seconded by Mr. H. M. Spence
and was carried.

The constitution of the Association
as circulated to members was con-
firmed and adopted on the Chairman's
proposition seconded by Mr. H. M.
Spence.

Resolution for Proper Control

Proposing that a letter should be
addressed to Dr. F. A. M. Noelting
expressing the thanks of the Asso-
ciation for the time and labour spent
by him in the work of organization and
furthering its objects, the Chairman
stated that the Association had sustain-
ed a heavy loss by the unexpected
departure of Dr. Noelting, who
was responsible for the formation of
the Association. During the time he
had been in office, the Chairman
added, Dr. Noelting had expended a
great deal of time and energy in the
interests of the Association and this
interest still continued, for Dr. Noelt-
ing, in a recent letter, had enquired
about the work of the Association.
The proposition was seconded by Mr.
H. M. Spence and was carried.

Mr. G. E. Matthews then proposed
the following resolution:

"That this meeting views with alarm
the serious problems confronting re-
sidents and property owners in the
Western (Extra-Settlement) area and
requests the incoming committee to
consider ways and means of bringing
to the notice of the Municipal Council,
whether by the submission of a resolu-
tion at the forthcoming Ratepayers'
Meeting or otherwise, the following
matters:
(a) the question of adequate
policing,
(b) sanitation, fire prevention and
other public health and public works
matters,
(c) effective control of factories,
(d) representation of the Western
(Extra-Settlement) Association on any
committees appointed by the Shang-
hai Municipal Council to discuss and
conduct negotiations with other au-
thorities to ensure proper control of
the Western (Extra-Settlement) area."

In proposing the above resolution
Mr. Matthews stated: "The reason
for the change in this resolution is to
leave more freedom of action to the
incoming committee, so that they may
adopt the procedure which seems
most likely to achieve success in im-
proving conditions in the Western
district. It would not in my opinion
be wise to tie them down to any
particular line of action."
page_data.zh:
成就斐然

然而，尽管有这段令人痛心的恶化历程，正如我在开场白中提到的那样，你们的委员会在制止弊端方面取得了许多成就，在预防以令人反感的工厂和职业形式出现的滋扰方面甚至取得了更多成就。要取得成果，必须不断观察并立即采取行动，正是在观察和报告滋扰行为方面，你们的委员会请求协会成员全心全意地合作，以便他们能够接触违规者或有关当局。

我要强调这样一个事实，即这是一个国际性协会，成员可以通过其领事代表和商会推动改革，从而发挥重要作用。我们希望并相信，不久之后，像我们协会这样的代表性机构将在其所代表地区的治理和控制中施加明确而持久的影响，并在工部局与其他当局的交涉中提供宝贵的协助。

关于账目，你们将看到去年我们收取了1,240美元的会费，目前手头结余为265.79美元。最后，主席提议通过截至1939年2月28日的财政年度的委员会报告和账目。该提议由 H. M. Spence 先生附议，并获得通过。

经主席提议、H. M. Spence 先生附议，确认并通过了分发给成员的协会章程。

要求适当控制的决议

主席提议致信 F. A. M. Noelting 博士，感谢他在组织工作和推进协会目标方面所花费的时间和精力。主席表示，Noelting 博士的意外离任使协会遭受了重大损失，他是协会成立的负责人。主席补充说，在他任职期间，Noelting 博士为协会的利益投入了大量的时间和精力，这种关注仍在继续，因为 Noelting 博士在最近的一封信中询问了协会的工作情况。该提议由 H. M. Spence 先生附议，并获得通过。

随后，G. E. Matthews 先生提出了以下决议：

“鉴于西部（界外）地区居民和业主面临的严重问题，本次会议对此表示关切，并请新一届委员会考虑通过何种方式和方法，无论是通过在即将召开的纳税人会议上提交决议还是其他方式，提请工部局注意以下事项：
(a) 充分警务的问题，
(b) 卫生、防火及其他公共卫生和公共工程事项，
(c) 对工厂的有效管控，
(d) 西部（界外）协会在工部局为讨论并与其它当局进行谈判以确保对西部（界外）地区进行适当控制而设立的任何委员会中的代表权。”

在提出上述决议时，Matthews 先生说：“修改此决议的原因是为了给新一届委员会留下更多的行动自由，以便他们采取最有可能成功改善西区状况的程序。在我看来，将他们束缚于任何特定的行动路线是不明智的。”

page_data.en:
Complicated Situation
The main object of the resolution
is to keep before the Council the
question of conditions in the Western
area district and to emphasize the
necessity of their continuous attention
and I think we should be wise to give
the incoming committee a free hand
insofar as ways and means are con-
cerned.
We have been assured of the Coun-
cil's sympathetic co-operation and
we must admit that they have done a
great deal in very difficult circum-
stances. At the present time they
are confronted with an extra-
ordinarily complicated situation and
we should be very careful not to add
to their difficulties by any action on
our part.
That does not mean, however, that
we should relax our efforts and leave
it all to them. Though they are much
better than they might have been,
conditions in the outside roads are
still very bad.
This Association has done useful
work in the past and can continue
to do useful work in the future, not
so much by urging the Council to do
something, but by co-operating with
it in reporting specific instances of
nuisances and objectionable enter-
prises, and by making constructive
suggestions based on first hand ex-
periences of the evils we are trying
to remedy. In this way the Associa-
tion can be, and should be, as useful
to the Council as to its members.
The first three points of the resolu-
tion do not need much comment.
They merely restate the aims of the
Association though I would like to
remark that it is evident from the
recent barricading and wiring off of
the entrances to the "enclaves" that
the Council is fully alive to the situa-
tion, and is doing its best to prevent
a recurrence of the incidents that
happened some weeks ago.

Council Activity
The Public Works and Health
Departments are very busy trying to
solve the problems created by the
enormous increase in the Chinese
population of the district and I know
that the Industrial Section is very
active in regard to factories.
The last point is one that, unfortun-
ately, is not a matter of immediate
importance, but sooner or later there
will come a time when the status of
the Western (Extra-Settlement) dis-
trict will have to be settled. It is I
think a reasonable request that the
property owners and residents of the
district should be consulted and re-
presented. They are the people
chiefly concerned. Their views
should be considered and so far as I
know the situation they are likely to
be considered."
The resolution was seconded by Mr.
W. Mellor and was carried.
Addressing the Chairman from the
floor, Mr. A. Harvey stated that he
was not a member of the Association
and that he had acted independently
in connection with nuisances in
Tunsin Road, adding that he had got
an almost immediate response from
the Public Health Department, who
were still offering him their services.
In connection with the factories which
were offensive, he added that he took
a strong line and went to see Public
Works Department officials and those
of the S.M.C. Secretariat.
"I could get nowhere with them,"
he continued, "and it was my im-
pression that from the beginning they
did not take a strong enough line
when they saw the factories begin-
ning to collect in the Western dis-
trict." It appeared to him, he went
on, that they had absolutely "bungled"
the Western area. Mr. Harvey then
stated that he had appealed to the
Council to stop vehicular traffic on
the side roads, as it was evident that
this traffic was doing a lot of harm
to the roads, which were already in
a bad condition. Most of this traffic,
he said, was causing a great deal of
expense to the ratepayers, all of it
going into territory where people paid
no rates whatsoever.
page_data.zh:
复杂局势
本决议的主要目的是使理事会持续关注西区（Western area district）的状况问题，并强调必须对此保持持续的关注；我认为，在涉及方法和手段方面，我们应当明智地给予新当选的委员会充分的自主权。
我们已得到理事会同情的合作保证，并且我们必须承认，他们在非常困难的情况下已经做了大量工作。目前，他们面临着极其复杂的局面，我们应格外小心，避免因我方的任何行动而增加他们的困难。
然而，这并不意味着我们应该放松努力，将一切完全留给他们处理。尽管情况比可能出现的要好得多，但越界筑路区域（outside roads）的状况仍然非常糟糕。
本协会在过去开展了有益的工作，未来也能继续开展有益的工作，其方式并非主要在于敦促理事会采取行动，而在于与理事会合作，报告具体的滋扰事件和令人反感的经营活动，并根据我们试图补救的弊病的第一手经验提出建设性建议。通过这种方式，本协会能够且应当对理事会及其会员同样有用。
决议的前三点无需过多评论。它们只是重申了本协会的宗旨，不过我想指出，从最近对“飞地”（enclaves）入口进行路障封锁和铁丝网隔离的情况来看，理事会显然充分意识到了局势，并正在尽最大努力防止数周前发生的事件重演。

理事会活动
工务局和卫生局正忙于解决因该区中国人口急剧增加而产生的问题，我知道工业科在工厂事务方面非常活跃。
最后一点不幸的是并非当务之急，但迟早会有这样一个时刻，即必须解决西部（越界筑路）地区的地位问题。我认为，征询该地区业主和居民的意见并让他们得到代表，是一个合理的要求。他们是主要利害关系人。他们的观点应当得到考虑，就我所知，这些观点很可能会得到考虑。”
该决议由 W. Mellor 先生附议，并获得通过。
A. Harvey 先生从席间向主席发言称，他并非本协会会员，他在处理 Tunxin Road（音译：敦信路/屯新路）的滋扰问题时是独立行动的，并补充说，他从卫生局得到了几乎立即的回应，该局至今仍向他提供服务。关于那些造成妨害的工厂，他补充说，他采取了强硬立场，去见了工务局官员以及工部局秘书处的官员。
“我和他们谈不出什么结果，”他继续说道，“给我的印象是，从一开始，当他们看到工厂开始在西區聚集时，他们采取的立场就不够强硬。”在他看来，他们完全“搞砸了”西区的事务。Harvey 先生随后表示，他曾呼吁理事会停止支路上的车辆通行，因为显然这种交通对道路造成了很大损害，而这些道路的状况本来就已经很差。他说，大部分此类交通给纳税人带来了巨大开支，而所有这些车辆都进入了人们根本不缴纳捐税的区域。

page_data.en:
"Weak-kneed"
He suggested the adoption of measures which would compel factories to move into Japanese-occupied territory, where their presence would create no hardship whatsoever. In Yangtzepoo he had seen quite a number of factories working peacefully as long as they complied with the regulations of the district.
"If these conditions go on," he stated, "it will be almost impossible for us to live in the Western district." He suggested making representations to the Council as Mr. Matthews had suggested, representatives of the Association being appointed to committees to negotiate with the several powers in the Western district. This was most important, he felt, because a strong line of action was needed, especially by the Public Works Department.
He added that in his opinion the above Department had shown a "weak-kneed" and condescending policy by its answers through the formal channels of the Secretariat. "They always back out by saying they can't do anything because of the international situation. I don't thinkt he Japanese would object to the Chinese being compelled to move from that area or because of the fact that measures would be taken in the district," he concluded,

Repercussions
Mr. W. A. Hogarth stated that the incoming committee should endeavour to assure themselves that their actions would not bring unwarranted repercussions as between the Council and the Japanese or "Ta Tao" authorities. Such action would make it more difficult for the Council to improve conditions. It would be a wise step, he added, if members were to talk over the various questions with the S.M.C. before bringing them up at the Ratepayers' Meeting.
In reply the Chairman stated that the Association would endeavour not to embarrass the Council in its dealings with other authorities. He added that it would confine itself as far as possible to constructive suggestions to the Council.
The committee was then elected as follows: Messrs. N. F. Allman, L. Basset, J.T.W. Broke, A. W. Buck, H. W. Davis, J. B. Ethrington, Frithjof Hoehnhke, L. E. Hudec, J. R. Jones, G. E. Matthews, W. Mellor, David Toeg, Commdr. J. M. Doyle and Dr. Thomas B. Dunn.
Stating that the Council were always remarking that it was difficult to prevent factories from springing up in the Western area, a non-member of the Association attending the meeting asked if it would not be possible for the authorities to cut off the power supply to such factories which could be classed as offensive.
He added that if the power could be cut off, some measure of control could be exerted over these factories, many of which would be compelled to move. In reply the Chairman stated that he did not think the Council had any power in this direction. The power supply was controlled by the Western District Power Co. which supplied power to any consumer, regardless of the Council's wishes. In the case of the Waterworks Co., however, it would be possible, he added.
page_data.zh:
“软弱无力”
他建议采取强制措施，迫使工厂迁入日占区，在那里它们的存在不会造成任何困难。在杨树浦（Yangtzepoo），他看到许多工厂只要遵守该区的规定，就能和平经营。
“如果这种情况持续下去，”他表示，“我们在西区生活将几乎变得不可能。”他建议按照 Matthews 先生的提议向理事会提出交涉，由本协会的代表加入委员会，与西区的各方势力进行谈判。他认为这一点至关重要，因为需要采取强有力的行动，尤其是工务局需要如此。
他补充说，在他看来，上述部门通过秘书处的正式渠道所作的答复，表现出一种“软弱无力”且居高临下的政策。“他们总是退缩，声称由于国际局势而无法采取任何行动。我不认为日本人会反对强迫中国人从该区域迁出，或者反对在该地区采取措施，”他总结道，

反响
W. A. Hogarth 先生表示，新当选的委员会应努力确保其行动不会在理事会与日本当局或“大道”（Ta Tao）当局之间引起不必要的反响。此类行动将使理事会更难改善状况。他补充说，如果会员们在将各种问题提交纳税人会议之前，先与工部局（S.M.C.）进行讨论，将是一个明智之举。
作为回应，主席表示，本协会将努力不在理事会与其他当局的交涉中使其陷入尴尬境地。他补充说，协会将尽可能局限于向理事会提出建设性建议。
随后选举产生的委员会成员如下：N. F. Allman、L. Basset、J.T.W. Broke、A. W. Buck、H. W. Davis、J. B. Ethrington、Frithjof Hoehnhke、L. E. Hudec、J. R. Jones、G. E. Matthews、W. Mellor、David Toeg、J. M. Doyle 指挥官和 Thomas B. Dunn 博士。
鉴于理事会常称难以防止工厂在西区涌现，一位出席本次会议的非协会会员询问，当局是否有可能切断那些可被归类为造成妨害的工厂的电力供应。
他补充说，如果能够切断电源，就可以对这些工厂实施一定程度的控制，其中许多工厂将被迫搬迁。作为回应，主席表示他认为理事会在此方面没有任何权力。电力供应由西区电力公司（Western District Power Co.）控制，该公司不顾理事会的意愿，向任何消费者供电。不过，他补充说，在水务公司（Waterworks Co.）的情况下，这是可能的。

page_data.en:
Not Recognized

Mr. W. H. Way stated that at a meeting of the British Residents' Association he had asked that something should be done to enable people living on the outside roads to make their grievances known in a proper way to the Council. He was told that the Council did not recognize the Western (Extra-Settlement) Association because of the fact that other bodies might ask for a similar association in other districts.

He asked why bodies like the British Residents' Association and the Western (Extra-Settlement) Association did not try to get some form of recognition from the Council. There might be grave objections against taking this step, he added, and it would be a good idea for the Association to look into the matter. Some action should be asked from the authorities as people in the Western district paid rates. So far it appeared that nothing was being done to extend the vote to these people. They had no right to say anything, he added, and still they had to pay their rates.

Replying, the Chairman stated that Section "D" of Resolution 2 covered a great deal of the ground which Mr Way had brought up.

Mr. N. F. Allman then asked that the committee extend an invitation to Mr. Way to join the Association, in view of the fact that he had mentioned that he was not a member.

On the proposition of the Chairman, seconded by Mr. H. M. Spence Messrs. Beck & Swann were appointed secretaries to the Association.

The meeting closed with a vote of thanks to the Chairman.
page_data.zh:
未获承认

W. H. Way 先生表示，在英国居民协会（British Residents' Association）的一次会议上，他曾要求采取某些措施，使居住在越界筑路区域的人们能够以适当的方式向理事会表达他们的不满。他被告知，理事会不承认西部（越界筑路）协会，因为其他团体可能会要求在其他地区建立类似的协会。

他问道，像英国居民协会和西部（越界筑路）协会这样的团体为何不尝试从理事会获得某种形式的承认。他补充说，采取这一步骤可能会有严重的反对意见，协会调查此事是个好主意。既然西区居民缴纳捐税，就应当要求当局采取一些行动。到目前为止，似乎没有任何举措将这些人的投票权扩展至他们身上。他补充说，他们无权发表任何意见，却仍必须缴纳捐税。

作为回应，主席表示，决议第2条的D款涵盖了 Way 先生提出的大部分内容。

随后，N. F. Allman 先生提议，鉴于 Way 先生提到自己不是会员，委员会应向 Way 先生发出加入本协会的邀请。

经主席提议，H. M. Spence 先生附议，任命 Beck & Swann 为本协会秘书。

会议在对主席的感谢声中闭幕。

March 18, 1939.

To the Special Branch.

There are about 600 families comprising several
thousand hut dwellers in the vicinity of Brenan and Keswick
Roads. On March 11 and 12 barbed wire barricades were
placed around their abodes, thus cutting off their communica-
tion with the municipal roads. The hut dwellers are seriously
inconvenienced because they are compelled to use water from
wells which is dirty and unhygienic. In case of fire, no
water is available. Night soil carts are also prevented
from passing through the barricade and the dwellers are
pouring night soil into sewers which causes a very bad smell.
This state of affairs has caused misery to the dwellers who
are unable to remove elsewhere owing to financial reasons.
We therefore earnestly request that two openings be effected
in the barricades, one at Si Sing Ka Street leading to Keswick
Road and the other at Si Poh Ka Street leading to Brenan Road.
Removal of 4 or 5 feet of barbed wire at each opening will
be quite sufficient to allow passage of night soil carts.
If this can be done the dwellers will be extremely grateful.

Representatives of hut dwellers :
Yang Zoong Zung
Wong Sui Tsz
Wong Shih Tan
Tsai Sing Wan and 9 others.

Communication address :-
Foh Shing Teashop, Si Sing Ka Street, Keswick Road.

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

FEB 14 1939

The Badlands:
What Might be Done

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"

SIR,—Reference the clear-cut statement issued by the S.M.C. regarding maintenance of order in the Western District of Shanghai outside the Settlement boundary, it appears that the position might be further clarified by action on the part of the authorities responsible for the Defence Scheme.

Against external aggression, the defence of the Settlement is allocated approximately as follows:—

"A" Sector—Yangtszepoo and Hongkew to Soochow Creek and North Kinagse Road—Japanese Forces.
"B" Sector—North Kiangse, Boundary and North Thibet Roads—British Forces.
"C" Sector—Soochow Creek from Yu Ya Ching to Kiaochow Roads—U.S. Force.
"D" Sector—Soochow Creek to Brenan Road Railway crossing, and Railway Line from Soochow Creek to Rockhill Avenue/Hungjao Road junction—Italian and British Forces.

It has been conclusively proved that armed terrorist activities within the Settlement emanate from the area west of the Settlement boundary, inside the Defence perimeter controlled by British and Italian Forces. As the S.M.C. has authority to police the roads only in this area, it would seem to be the immediate duty of the British and Italian Forces, under existing conditions, to declare a state of emergency in "D" Sector in order to carry out their part of the Defence Scheme to protect the Settlement from external aggression.

EBOR.

Shanghai, Feb. 13.

（手写批注：C 1/2）

先生，——鉴于工部局就维持上海租界边界以外西区秩序所发布的明确声明，看来负责防御计划之当局若能采取行动，局势或可进一步澄清。

针对外来侵略，租界的防御部署大致如下：—

“A”区——杨树浦及虹口至苏州河及江西路北路——日军。
“B”区——江西北路、界路及西藏北路——英军。
“C”区——苏州河，从虞洽卿路至胶州路——美军。
“D”区——苏州河至白利南路铁路道口，以及从苏州河至罗别根路/虹桥路交汇处的铁路线——意军和英军。

已有确凿证据表明，租界内的武装恐怖活动源于租界边界以西、由英意军队控制的防御 perimeter（防线）内的区域。由于工部局仅有权在该区域的道路上行使警察权，因此在现有条件下，英意军队似乎有当务之急，即在“D”区宣布进入紧急状态，以履行其防御计划中保护租界免受外来侵略的部分职责。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.
JAN 28 1939

‘Ta Tao’ Policemen Put
In Jail For Complicity
In Gangsters’ Escape

Two Guards Fail To
Explain Absence
From Post

Two Chinese members of the
“Shanghai City Government” police
force, believed to have been con-
cerned in the escape of four Chin-
ese gangsters from the Japanese
gendarmerie house of detention on
Jessfield Road Wednesday night,
are themselves in jail today.

The two policemen were arrested
Thursday morning after they failed
to give an unsatisfactory account
of their whereabouts on the night
of the escape. This is according
to information obtained from au-
thoritative sources by THE CHINA
PRESS yesterday afternoon.

The four Chinese gangsters who
escaped from the hands of the
Japanese authorities were being
held in a row of garages at the
rear of the Japanese gendarmerie
station at 92-94 Jessfield Road.
Chinese police of the “Shanghai
City Government” also use the
same station.

Chinese as Guards

To prevent the escape of prison-
ers from the gendarmerie deten-
tion “cells,” both Chinese and
Japanese guards are used. Two
Chinese guards, armed with rifles,
were stationed near the entrance
to the row of garages and not far
from the garage in which the nine
gangsters arrested by Settlement
detectives during the recent raid
and shooting affair in Fah Wah
Village were being kept.

The story told in official Settle-
ment circles is that when the four
gangsters escaped from their
“cells,” the two Chinese guards
were not on duty as they should
have been. It also was reported
in the Settlement last night
that they were unable to give a
satisfactory explanation to the
Japanese authorities of their
absence from duty and were
accordingly locked up.

Meanwhile, the four gangsters
are still at large. Their five com-
panions, comprising two men and
three women, are still in the hands
of the Japanese authorities and
there is no indication as to when
they might be turned over to the
Settlement police authorities.

Case Weakened

While Shanghai Municipal Police
officials are offering no comment
concerning the escape of the
thugs, it is believed that the case
against the gang has been
materially weakened as a result of
the disappearance of the ring-
leaders. Two of the four men who
escaped were known to have been
the “brains” of the entire mob.

The gangsters in the hands of
the Japanese authorities were
nabbed by foreign detectives of
Crime Branch Headquarters, S.M.P.,
during a raid in Fah Wah Village
on the afternoon of January 4.
The thugs were suspected of
having been concerned in the rob-
bery of a party of foreigners on
Columbia Road on the night of
December 28.

After their arrest, Japanese
gendarmes who happened to be
in the area took over the custody
of the gangsters arrested by the
Settlement police after promising
to hand them back. They were
handed back in three days time
but with the provision that the
police turn the men over to the
Japanese for interrogation, after
which they would be returned to
the S.M.P.

The S.M.P. handed the men over
to the Japanese on January 12 but
since then, no effort to hand them
back has been made. And now, to
further complicate the situation,
four of the men have escaped.

Japanese Charges

Charging the Shanghai Munici-
pal Council with “interference” in
the western district, the Tairiku
Shimpo, local Japanese daily, yes-
terday made the statement that the
S.M.C. has assumed a “challenging
attitude in interfering with the
functions of the ‘Greater Shang-
hai Special Municipality.’ ”

Among other things, the paper
claimed that police officials of the
Settlement informed the “Shang-
hai City Government” that they
had instructions to prohibit en-
trance and passage of police
constables of the “Reformed
Government” into alleyways or
both sides of extra-Settlement
roads.

From high police sources, THE
CHINA PRESS learned last night
that no order to this effect was
issued.

The same Japanese paper also
stated the S.M.C. had adopted a
resolution stating it would not
recognize collection of salt taxes
by the “Reformed Government” on
extra-Settlement roads. This also
was denied by an S.M.C. spokes-
man.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》。
1939年1月28日

“大道”警察因
协助匪徒逃脱
入狱

两名警卫无法
解释缺勤原因

据信与周三晚间四名中国匪徒从杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road，即极司菲尔路）日本宪兵队拘留所逃脱一案有关的“上海市政府”警察部队中的两名华籍警员，今日自身也身陷囹圄。

这两名警察于周四上午被捕，原因是他们未能就逃脱当晚的行踪给出令人满意的解释。这是《大美晚报》昨日下午从权威渠道获得的消息。

这四名从日本当局手中逃脱的中国匪徒，当时被关押在杰斯菲尔德路92-94号日本宪兵队站后方的一排车库内。“上海市政府”的中国警察也使用该站。

华籍警卫

为防止囚犯从宪兵队拘留“牢房”逃脱，使用了华籍和日籍警卫。两名手持步枪的华籍警卫驻守在那排车库的入口附近，距离关押近期在法华村（Fah Wah Village）突袭和枪击事件中被租界侦探逮捕的九名匪徒的车库不远。

租界官方圈子里流传的说法是，当这四名匪徒从他们的“牢房”逃脱时，这两名华籍警卫并未按规定在岗。昨晚租界内也有报道称，他们无法向日方当局对其缺勤给出令人满意的解释，因此被关押。

与此同时，这四名匪徒仍在逃。他们的五名同伙（包括两名男子和三名女子）仍掌握在日本当局手中，目前尚无迹象表明何时会将他们移交给租界警方当局。

案件削弱

虽然上海公共租界警务处官员对暴徒逃脱一事不予置评，但人们认为，由于头目的失踪，针对该帮派的案件已被大大削弱。逃脱的四名男子中有两人已知是整个团伙的“智囊”。

掌握在日本当局手中的匪徒，是于1月4日下午在法华村的一次突袭中，被上海公共租界警务处刑事总部的外籍侦探抓获的。这些暴徒涉嫌参与了12月28日晚在哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road，即海格路）抢劫一群外国人的案件。

被捕后，恰逢在该地区的日本宪兵接管了由租界警察逮捕的匪徒，并承诺将其归还。他们在三天后被归还，但附带条件是警方需将这些人移交给日方进行审讯，之后他们将交还上海公共租界警务处。

上海公共租界警务处于1月12日将这些人移交给日方，但此后未再努力将其交还。如今，四人逃脱使局势更加复杂。

日方指控

当地日文日报《大陆新报》昨日指责上海工部局在西区进行“干涉”，并称工部局采取了“挑战性的态度，干涉‘上海特别市’的职能”。

该报还声称，租界警方官员告知“上海市政府”，他们接到指令，禁止“维新政府”的巡捕进入小巷或租界外道路的两侧。

《大美晚报》昨晚从警方高层获悉，并未发布此类命令。

同一份日文报纸还称，工部局已通过一项决议，表示不承认“维新政府”在租界外道路征收盐税。这也遭到了工部局发言人的否认。

(Editor's Note: This is the second
of a series of five articles reviewing
crime in Shanghai during the past
year. The third will appear in to-
morrow's issue).

By CARROLL ALCOTT

"Gun Battle off Avenue Edward
VII—Police Shoot it Out with
Bandit Gang!"

"Two Dead, Three Wounded When
Police Clash With Gangsters on Yu
Ya Ching Road!"

Headlines like these were common-
place in Shanghai newspapers last
year. They made their appearance
on an average of one every week.
They were vivid indication of the
fact that Shanghai, once again, was
living up to an old reputation of

being the toughest town on earth.
They offered evidence that Shang-
hai's armed robber gangs were more
active than at any time since the
crime wave that followed the 1927
trouble in this area.

It is true that open clashes with
political terrorists accounted for
some of the shootings between the
police of the International Settle-
ment and the French Concession
last year. These, however, were
much in the minority. Armed robber
bands were responsible for most of
the gun battles.

Tough Character

Stripped of his usual working-man
appearance and boiled down to the
fundamentals of his real character
the Shanghai armed robber is one
of the toughest criminal types to
be found in the Orient. He shoots
first and asks questions if or when
he happens to get caught.

His methods of dealing with his

victims are rough in the extreme.
Binding and gagging a whole family
and then leaving father, mother,
brother, sisters and relatives scatter-
ed about the floor, to free themselves
as best they can, mean nothing to
him.

Despite his boldness, the fact that
he operates almost as efficiently in
the full light of the day as he does
at night, and his willingness to
"shoot it out" with the law rather
than surrender, the Shanghai bandit
seldom remains a free and roving
spirit.

The Settlement and French police
have proven themselves capable of
dealing with this sort of criminal
and the armed robber is lucky who
keeps out of jail longer than six
months after starting his career in
this class of crime.

作者：CARROLL ALCOTT

“爱德华七世大道发生枪战——警方与匪帮交火！”

“警察在虞洽卿路与匪徒冲突，两死三伤！”

去年，这类标题在上海报纸上屡见不鲜。它们平均每周出现一次。它们生动地表明，上海再次印证了其作为

地球上最硬核城市的旧名声。
这些报道提供了证据，表明上海的武装抢劫帮派比1927年该地区动荡引发的犯罪浪潮以来的任何时候都更为活跃。

诚然，去年国际租界和法租界警察之间的一些枪战是由与政治恐怖分子的公开冲突造成的。然而，这些只占少数。大多数枪战是由武装抢劫团伙引起的。

强硬角色

剥去其通常的工人外表，提炼出其真实性格的基本要素，上海武装抢劫犯是东方发现的最强硬的罪犯类型之一。他先开枪，如果或当他碰巧被抓时，再回答问题。

他对待受害者的

手段极其粗暴。将全家人捆绑并堵住嘴巴，然后让父亲、母亲、兄弟、姐妹和亲戚散落在地板上，让他们自行设法解脱，这对他来说毫无意义。

尽管他胆大妄为，几乎能在光天化日之下像夜间一样高效地作案，并且宁愿与法律“交火”也不愿投降，但上海匪徒很少能长期保持自由流窜的状态。

租界和法国警察已证明有能力对付这类罪犯，从事此类犯罪的武装抢劫犯若能入狱时间不超过六个月，就算幸运了。

and along the streets of the Inter-
national Settlement and the French

January 1, 1938 to midnight,

This figure covers only the arm-
ed robberies reported to the police.
It is a well-known fact that, in
Shanghai, many such crimes are
never reported. Fearing reprisals
at the hands of the brigands some

The tendency, on the part of the
more illiterate classes of Chinese,
to hide a crime committee against
them, has been a handicap to the
suppression of criminal activities
in this city ever since the arrival
of the foreigner.
It is a tendency that is dis-
appearing, however, especially
among Chinese who have lived in
the foreign-controlled areas for an
extended period of time. Educa-
tional campaigns by the police
have contributed much toward the
eradication of the fear of reprisals
from bandits felt in the lower
class sections of the population.
Hence, it is logical to presume
that not more than 200 robberies
and holdups went unreported last
year, thereby bringing the total
for both the Settlement and the
Concession to approximately 1,000.

Reported Cases

Armed robberies reported in the
International Settlement last year,
according to the monthly records
of the Shanghai Municipal Police
reached the impressive figure of
587.
Approximately 100 other rob-
beries, including holdups, were
committed, bringing the total to
near the 600 mark, or an average
of slightly more than 11 per
week. Not since the latter part
of 1927 and early in 1928 has the
figure for this class of crime in
Shanghai been so high.
A similar condition existed in
the French Concession. Although
exact figures are not available, the
daily French Police reports issued
to the press indicate that at least
150 armed robberies, holdups and
robberies in which force was em-
ployed to relieve a victim of his
wealth, committed in Frenchtown

police. When the annual French
Police report is issued, the final
figure revealed may even prove to
be much greater.
The reasons for this unhappy
state of affairs, of course, are
quite obvious to anyone who has
resided in Shanghai since August
13, 1937. Various unpleasant situa-
tions created by the hostilities are
to blame.
For instance, guns have been
more plentiful and easier to get
than at any time in Shanghai
history. As evidence of this state-
ment, witness the fact that the
Settlement police seized more than
300 pistols, revolvers and other
firearms from armed bandit gangs
during the year. This figure, com-
pared with firearm seizures made
in previous years, is almost a re-
cord.
January, 1938, was the record
month of the year for gun seizures.
Sixty-four weapons were seized
from armed gangsters by the

持枪歹徒在本地中国村庄制造恐怖统治

在1938年1月1日至同年12月31日午夜这12个月期间，心怀叵测的暴徒在国际租界和法租界的住宅、商店及街道上实施了800多起抢劫案。这一数字仅涵盖向警方报案的武装抢劫案。众所周知，在上海，许多此类犯罪从未被报告。由于害怕遭到匪徒报复，一些受害者选择对损失保持沉默，而不愿报警。自外国人抵达以来，中国较不识字的阶层倾向于隐瞒针对他们的犯罪行为，这一直阻碍着本市对犯罪活动的镇压。

然而，这种倾向正在消失，尤其是在那些在外国控制区生活了较长时间的中国人中间。警方的宣传教育活动在很大程度上有助于消除下层民众中对匪徒报复的恐惧。因此，可以合理推测，去年未报案的抢劫和拦路抢劫案不超过200起，从而使租界和法租界的案件总数达到约1,000起。

已报案案件

根据上海公共租界工部局警务处的月度记录，去年国际租界内报告的武装抢劫案达到了令人瞩目的587起。

另有约100起其他抢劫案（包括拦路抢劫）发生，使总数接近600起，即平均每周略多于11起。自1927年下半年和1928年初以来，上海此类犯罪的数量从未如此之高。

法租界也存在类似情况。虽然确切数据尚不可得，但法国警方每日向新闻界发布的报告显示，去年在法租界至少发生了150起武装抢劫、拦路抢劫以及使用武力掠夺受害人财物的抢劫案，且这些案件已向警方报案。待年度法国警方报告发布时，最终披露的数字甚至可能证明要大得多。

当然，对于任何自1937年8月13日以来居住在上海的人来说，造成这种不幸局势的原因是十分明显的。敌对行动造成的各种不利局面是罪魁祸首。

例如，枪支比上海历史上任何时候都更加充足且更容易获得。作为这一说法的证据，请看这样一个事实：在这一年中，租界警方从武装匪帮手中缴获了300多支手枪、左轮手枪和其他火器。与往年缴获的火器数量相比，这一数字几乎创下了纪录。

1938年1月是全年缴获枪支最多的月份。上海公共租界工部局警务处从武装暴徒手中缴获了64支武器。其中一些是恐怖分子使用的枪支，但大多数是从武装抢劫犯手中缴获的武器。

The same month also witnessed
99 armed robberies in the Inter-

Police On Job
On the whole, the Shanghai
Municipal Police, badly over-
worked in almost every depart-
ment as a result of the
hostilities, performed an excel-
lent job in dealing with the armed
robbery situation. Approximately
1,200 arrests were made, or an aver-
age of 100 armed bandit suspects per
month. This figure does not include
the number of terrorists arrested.
The Settlement police also seized an
average of 25 gangster guns every
month.
Despite this effort on the part of
the Settlement law enforcement
body, plenty of guns were still in
the hands of the bandits when
January of the current year arrived.
No less than 56 armed robberies
were committed during December
1938 and this criminal activity
continued on a major scale after
the New Year.
The point to be deduced is that
so many guns, mostly Mausers, were
left strewn about on the battlefields
after the Chinese withdrawal from
this area in November, 1937, that
gangsters experienced but little dif-
ficulty in getting their hands on
them.
Furthermore, it seems to be a
foregone conclusion that the police
of both the International Settle-
ment and the French Concession
will have their hands full for the
next year or two before most of
these guns are finally out of circula-
tion.
In this connection, the most
unusual development during the
year was the uncovering of informa-
tion revealing that several gangs in
the Shanghai area have been
reaping good incomes from the
rental of pistols and hand grenades
to other mobs.
A Coolie And His Racket
One of the biggest racketeers in
the gun rental business arrested
during the year was a lone coolie
who had picked up several weapons
from the battlefields.
The fellow brought the guns inside
the Settlement and hid them under
the back porches of foreign and
Chinese residences in the western
district. The police finally caught
up with him while engaged in run-
ning down a band of thugs
responsible for more than half a
dozen crimes of violence staged in
the Great Western Road area.
The coolie admitted that he was
operating a gun rental business and
that he received as much as $5 per
night for the use of a Mauser. He
also rented hand-grenades at $2 per
night.

grenades especially effective in

同月，国际租界还发生了99起武装抢劫案，创下全年纪录。尽管暴徒活动猖獗，但警方仍在积极工作，在1938年2月1日之前逮捕了256名持枪歹徒及其同伙。

警方在行动

总体而言，上海公共租界工部局警务处几乎每个部门都因敌对行动而工作过度，但在应对武装抢劫局势方面表现出色。共逮捕了约1,200人，即平均每月逮捕100名武装匪徒嫌疑人。这一数字不包括被捕的恐怖分子人数。租界警方还平均每月缴获25支帮派分子的枪支。

尽管租界执法机构做出了这些努力，但当今年一月到来时，仍有大量枪支掌握在匪徒手中。仅在1938年12月就发生了不少于56起武装抢劫案，且这种犯罪活动在新年后仍大规模持续。

由此可以推断，1937年11月中国军队从该地区撤退后，战场上遗留了大量枪支（主要是毛瑟枪），使得暴徒毫不费力就能弄到这些武器。

此外，似乎可以肯定的是，在国际租界和法租界，警方在未来一两年内都将忙于处理这些问题，直到这些枪支最终退出流通。

在此方面，这一年最不寻常的发展是揭露出一些信息，显示上海地区的几个帮派通过向其他团伙出租手枪和手榴弹获得了丰厚收入。

一名苦力及其勒索勾当

今年被捕的最大枪支租赁 racketeer（勒索者/非法经营者）之一是一名独自行动的苦力，他从战场上捡拾了几件武器。

此人将枪支带入租界，并藏在西区外国人和中国居民住宅的后门廊下。警方在追捕一个在大西路地区策划了六起以上暴力犯罪的暴徒团伙时，最终将其抓获。

该苦力承认他经营着一项枪支租赁业务，出租一支毛瑟枪每晚可收取高达5美元的费用。他还以每晚2美元的价格出租手榴弹。

他说，劫匪发现手榴弹在

frightening people into giving up
their valuables without making any
effort to protest. In other words,
the appearance of a bandit with a
grenade has a much more terrifying
effect on his intended victim than
a pistol.
Terror In Chinese Homes
While the average foreigner living
in Shanghai probably never gave
second thought to the matter, the
presence of large gangs of armed
robbers in this area has struck
terror into the hearts and minds of
the poorer classes of Chinese,
especially those living in the villages
of the western district.
Police investigations have revealed
that entire villages have been
terrorized by the nightly depreda-
tions of the bandits.
Hardest hit, in this respect, are
the Japanese-controlled areas off
extra-Settlement roads where the
bandits had almost a free hand most
of last year. No record of the
robberies committed in these areas
has been made available to Shang-
hai Municipal Police authorities but
it is estimated that the total runs
well into three figures. This is
according to information that has
seeped across the boundaries to
reach the ears of the police and
local newspapermen.
Want To Control Dens
Just how long this state of affairs
will continue is a matter that can
only be gessed at. While they are
reluctant to talk about it, I happen
to know that the average police
officer on the Settlement force feels
that if the gambling and opium dens
of the western area could be brought
under his jurisdiction, the problem
of reducing armed robbery in the
foreign concessions would be only a
matter of a few weeks at the most.
Experience in dealing with robber
gangs, during the past few months,
has taught the police that most of
the armed criminals who operate
inside the Settlement and the
French Concession, have their hide-
outs in the villages off extra-
Settlement roads.
And these areas, because of the
peculiar political situation existing
in the western district, are immune
from S.M.P. raids.
In other words, an armed robber
can commit a crime in the Settle-
ment, dash across the boundary line
and hide out until he thinks it safe
to return to stage another robbery.
It is true that this situation has
always existed in Shanghai but when
the Chinese National Government
authorities ran the municipal ad-
ministration of Greater Shanghai,
police of the foreign Settlements
were given the co-operation they
needed to make arrests in Chapel
and areas outside the Settlement.

恐吓人们交出贵重物品且不做任何反抗方面特别有效。换句话说，手持手榴弹的匪徒对其预定受害者产生的恐怖效果远超手枪。

中国家庭中的恐怖

虽然生活在上海的普通外国人可能对此事未加深思，但该地区存在大量武装抢劫团伙的情况已在贫穷的中国阶层心中投下了恐怖的阴影，尤其是那些居住在西区村庄的人。

警方调查显示，整个村庄都因匪徒夜间的掠夺行为而陷入恐怖之中。

在这方面受打击最严重的是越界筑路地区的日本控制区，去年大部分时间里，匪徒在这些地区几乎可以随心所欲地行动。上海公共租界工部局当局并未掌握在这些地区发生的抢劫案的记录，但据估计，总数高达三位数。这是根据渗透过边界传到警方和当地记者耳中的信息得出的。

希望控制窝点

这种状况将持续多久只能猜测。虽然他们不愿多谈，但我恰好知道，租界警队的普通警官认为，如果能够将西区的赌博和鸦片烟馆纳入其管辖范围，那么减少外国租界内武装抢劫的问题最多只需几周即可解决。

过去几个月处理抢劫团伙的经验告诉警方，大多数在国际租界和法租界内活动的武装罪犯，其藏身之处都在越界筑路地区的村庄里。

而这些地区，由于西区存在的特殊政治局势，免受上海公共租界工部局警务处的突袭搜查。

换句话说，一名武装抢劫犯可以在租界内作案，迅速越过边界线躲藏起来，直到他认为安全后再回来实施另一次抢劫。

诚然，这种情况在上海一直存在，但当中国国民政府当局管理大上海的市政行政时，外国租界的警方能够获得他们在闸北及租界以外地区进行逮捕所需的合作。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

FEB - 1939

MYSTERY SHOTS HIT
POLICE VAN

Chinese Driver Wounded
In Surprise Attack
On Keswick Road

A Chinese police chauffeur was seriously wounded in the right arm last night in Keswick Road when in S.M.P. patrol van was greeted by a hail of bullets shortly after 9 p.m. from a source that, at a late hour last night, still remained a mystery.

The patrol-van was proceeding along Keswick Road when, at a point some 250 yards south of Brenan Road, over a dozen shots struck the car from behind several penetrating the rear windows and one striking the Chinese driver on the right arm.

Sergeant Baldock and Russian Constable Vasilieff, who were sitting inside the car, had a miraculous escape from injury.

The attack was so sudden and took the occupants of the van so completely unawares that no attempt was made to return fire. The shooting ceased as soon as the car pulled up, and though intense investigations were conducted by the Police on the spot until late last night, no clues as to the identity of the assailants were forthcoming.

神秘枪击击中警车

中国司机在基斯威克路遭遇突袭受伤

昨晚9点后不久，一辆上海公共租界工部局警务处巡逻车在基斯威克路（Keswick Road）遭遇一阵子弹袭击，一名中国警察司机右臂受重伤。截至昨晚深夜，开枪来源仍是个谜。

巡逻车沿基斯威克路行驶时，在布伦南路（Brenan Road）以南约250码处，十多发子弹从后方击中车辆，穿透后窗，其中一发击中了中国司机的右臂。

坐在车内的鲍尔多克巡佐（Sergeant Baldock）和俄国巡捕瓦西里耶夫（Constable Vasilieff）奇迹般地未受伤。

袭击如此突然，车内人员完全措手不及，以至于未能尝试还击。停车后枪声立即停止，尽管警方在现场进行了紧张的调查直至昨晚深夜，但仍未获得关于袭击者身份的任何线索。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS
FEB 19 39
HIGH VELOCITY RIFLE USED ON RESERVE UNIT
S.M.P. Ballisticians Cannot Trace Type, Make of Bullets

Bullets which pierced the Reserve Unit van on
Keswick Road at 9:05 p.m. Monday were fired from a high velocity
rifle, ballistic experts of the Shanghai Municipal Police proved
yesterday.

Neither the make nor type of the bullet could be
ascertained, for the missiles were shattered into several pieces
upon impact with the Reserve Unit van.

It was confirmed last night that the shots, four in
all, were fired from a spot west of the railway line, in Japanese-
controlled territory.

Police are at a loss as to the origin of the shots, for
for, as an official pointed out yesterday, few people dare carry
revolvers, let alone rifles, without permission, especially on
"Ta Tao" territory, where not even all the Chinese policemen are
entrusted with arms.

Other sources pointed out that the only people liable
to carry rifles in "Ta Tao" territory are Chinese guerillas and
Japanese sentries.

Nyi Ah-foh, the Reserve Unit chauffeur who was wounded
in the right arm above the elbow by one of the bullets which
pierced the car, was only lightly wounded, and is well on the road
to recovery.

File
C 1/2
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》
1939年2月19日
预备队车辆遭高速步枪射击
上海公共租界工部局弹道专家无法追踪子弹类型和制造商

上海公共租界工部局弹道专家昨日证实，周一晚上9:05在基斯威克路击穿预备队车辆（Reserve Unit van）的子弹是由一支高速步枪发射的。

由于子弹在撞击预备队车辆时碎裂成几块，因此无法确定子弹的品牌或类型。

昨晚证实，总共四发子弹是从铁路线以西、日本控制区内的一处地点发射的。

警方对枪击来源感到困惑，因为正如一位官员昨日指出的那样，很少有人敢在未经许可的情况下携带左轮手枪，更不用说步枪了，特别是在“大道”（Ta Tao，音译，指日占区或特定管制区）领土上，那里甚至连所有中国警察都不被信任持有武器。

其他消息来源指出，在“大道”领土上，唯一可能携带步枪的人是中国游击队员和日本哨兵。

预备队司机倪阿福（Nyi Ah-foh，音译）被击穿汽车的一颗子弹击中右臂肘部上方，伤势较轻，恢复情况良好。

档案
C 1/2

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
JAN 27 1939

Fah Hwa Bandits
Break Jail

Four Western Gangsters
Escape from “Ta Tao”
Station, Jessfield

Four members of the desperate
West Fah Hwa Village gang, who had
been arrested with several others by
the Settlement Police, were at large
yesterday after their escape from a
“Ta Tao” police station.

The Settlement Police at Bubbling
Well Station were informed by the
Japanese military police that the four
dangerous bandits had broken out of
the detention cell at “Ta Tao” police
headquarters, 92 Jessfield Road, on
Wednesday morning. Details of how
they managed to escape, however,
were lacking. The station whence
they fled adjoins the western head-
quarters of the Japanese military
police, 94 Jessfield Road, where also
Chinese prisoners are being held.

The four are members of the gang
which was “rounded up” as a result
of a frontal attack on its hiding-
place, a creekside hut some 200 yards
west of Columbia Road, by the Police
Reserve Unit and a large squad of
Headquarters detectives on January
4. Many shots were fired by both
sides before the gangsters surrender-
ed, dropping their guns into the
muddy creek.

Taken to Jessfield Road

The prisoners were retained in the
custody of the Japanese military
police and lodged by them in Jessfield
Road. The following afternoon the
bandits were handed over to the
Settlement Police for questioning, it
being stipulated by the Japanese that
they must be returned to them in
24 hours. The questioning revealed
that the gang was implicated in a
series of bold crimes of recent date
in the western “outside roads” area.
One of these outrages was an attack
by a large number of the bandits
upon two Chinese constables of the
Settlement Police in Brenan Road a
few weeks back. Both policemen
were robbed of their service pistols
at the time, but the weapons were
later recovered by the S.M.P.

The “clean-up” of the Fah Hwa
Village gang led to the subsequent
arrest of other desperadoes connected
with the band, in the Great West-
ern Road and Jessfield Village areas.

page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。
1939年1月27日

法华匪帮
越狱逃脱

四名西方歹徒
从极司菲尔路“大陶”
分局逃脱

四名穷凶极恶的法华村（Fah Hwa Village）西帮成员，此前曾与其他数人一同被租界巡捕房逮捕，昨日从“大陶”警察局逃脱后目前在逃。

静安寺分局接到日本宪兵队通知，称这四名危险匪徒于周三上午从位于极司菲尔路92号的“大陶”警察总部拘留所 breakout。然而，关于他们如何成功逃脱的细节尚不清楚。他们逃离的警局紧邻位于极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队西部总部，该处也关押着中国囚犯。

这四人是该帮派成员，该帮派于1月4日被警察后备队（Police Reserve Unit）和总部侦探大队正面突袭其藏身之处——哥伦比亚路以西约200码处的一间溪边棚屋——而被“一网打尽”。在匪徒投降并将枪支扔进泥泞的溪流之前，双方曾发生激烈枪战。

被带至极司菲尔路

囚犯由日本宪兵队羁押，并关押在极司菲尔路。次日下午，匪徒被移交给租界巡捕房进行审讯，日方规定必须在24小时内将他们交还。审讯显示，该帮派涉嫌近期在西部“越界筑路”地区实施的一系列大胆犯罪。其中一起暴行是几周前，大量匪徒在布伦南路（Brenan Road）袭击了两名租界巡捕房的中国巡捕。当时两名警察的服务用配枪被抢，但武器后来被上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）追回。

对法华村帮派的“清理”行动导致随后在大西路和极司菲尔村地区逮捕了与该帮派有关的其他亡命之徒。

CHINA PRESS.

JAN 27 1939

Gang Leaders Wanted
By S.M.P. Escape From
Nippon Police Custody

Four Vicious Criminals Captured In Fah Wah
Village By Settlement Authorities
Manage To Secure Freedom

Four gangsters wanted in the International Settlement made their escape from the Japanese authorities Wednesday morning, according to information obtained from authoritative circles by THE CHINA PRESS yesterday afternoon.

The four escaped men, it is stated were members of the gang rounded up recently in Fah Wah Village off Columbia Road and detained by the Japanese authorities.

Six men and three women comprised the mob. Although taken into custody by detectives of Crime Branch Headquarters, S.M.P. after a gun battle, Japanese gendarmes immediately took possession of the suspects. This happened more than three weeks ago.

Police Co-operate

A few days after the raid, the Japanese handed the gangsters over to the police but with the provision that they be handed back after interrogation. Wishing to co-operate with the Japanese, the police returned the gangsters. At the same time, the Nipponese gendarme authorities promised to return the mob to the Settlement authorities for trial in the First Special District Court.

The gang is badly wanted by the Shanghai Municipal Police since, it is alleged, that the ringleaders are two of the most vicious criminals to appear in Shanghai in many months.

Among other things, these two men, both of whom were arrested, are alleged to have engineered the armed robbery of several foreigners on Columbia Road on the night of December 28.

They are also wanted for trial on approximately 16 different counts of armed robbery, highway robbery and attempted murder.

News Leaks Out

News that four of the gangsters had made their escape from the Japanese authorities leaked out yesterday morning although the break is said to have occurred on the previous day.

Settlement police officials yesterday admitted that they had heard of the escape but could provide no details.

Whether the men escaped from Japanese gendarmerie headquarters or a "Shanghai City Government" police station could not be ascertained. But it was reported on reliable authority that two of the men who managed to free themselves are the ringleaders of the mob whom the Settlement police are anxious to keep in custody.

（手写批注：File C-1 R）
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》。

1939年1月27日

工部局警务处通缉的帮会头目
从日本警方 custody 中逃脱

四名在法华村被租界当局抓获的凶残罪犯
成功获得自由

据《大美晚报》昨日下午从权威渠道获悉，四名在国际租界被通缉的帮会分子于周三上午从日本当局手中逃脱。

据悉，这四名逃脱者是最近在哥伦比亚路附近的法华村（Fah Wah Village）被围捕并由日本当局拘留的帮派成员。

该团伙由六男三女组成。尽管在上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事科总部侦探经过枪战后将其收押，但日本宪兵立即接管了嫌疑人。此事发生在三周多以前。

警方合作

突袭几天后，日本人将匪徒移交给警方，但规定审讯后需交还。为了与日方合作，警方归还了匪徒。同时，日本宪兵当局承诺将该团伙交还租界当局，以便在第一特区法院受审。

上海公共租界工部局警务处急需抓捕该帮派，因为据称其头目是数月来出现在上海的最凶残的两名罪犯。

除其他事项外，据称这两名已被捕的男子策划了12月28日晚在哥伦比亚路对几名外国人实施的武装抢劫。

他们还因大约16项不同的武装抢劫、拦路抢劫和谋杀未遂罪名而受到通缉审判。

消息泄露

尽管据说逃脱发生在前一天，但四名匪徒从日本当局手中逃脱的消息于昨日上午泄露。

租界警方官员昨日承认已听闻逃脱一事，但无法提供细节。

这些人是从日本宪兵队总部还是从“上海市政府”警察局逃脱，尚无法确定。但有可靠消息称，成功脱身的两人是该团伙的头目，租界警方正急于将其羁押。

（手写批注：File C-1 R）

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

Russian Woman Hit
By Gunman's Bullet
A Russian woman, T. Okladni-
kova, of- 268 Joffre Terrace, was
severely wounded last evening
when she and her companion
were held up by three armed men.
The gangsters stopped the pair on
Brenan Road, near Warren Road,
and demanded money and jewel-
lery. The woman screamed and
one of the gunmen fired, the
bullet striking her on the left side
and emerging on the right side.
An ambulance removed the
wounded woman to the Country
Hospital. Detectives were search-
ing the neighborhood for clues as
to the identity of the robbers but
have reported no arrests.

俄国女子
遭枪手子弹击中

昨晚，茹科夫台路（Joffre Terrace）268号的俄国女子T. Okladnikova与其同伴遭到三名持械男子拦截时受重伤。匪徒在华伦路附近的布伦南路拦下二人，索要钱财和珠宝。该女子尖叫，一名枪手开枪，子弹击中其左侧并从右侧穿出。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

Gangster Of Badlands
Shoots At Policemen

The crack of firearms was
heard again in the gangland
section of the western district
last night just before midnight
when a patrol of Chinese police
constables was the target of an
unknown assassin's bullet. The
men were patrolling Tunsin
Road on a routine tour of their
area when the sudden flash of
flame and report of a shot in-
terrupted the night. With
drawn pistols the men took
position ready to reply to any
further possible firing but a
glance down an alleyway re-
vealed the fleeing figure of a
man escaping into territory off
the municipal road. The police
fired no shots-and a checkup
of the detail reavealed the
hidden marksman had taken
poor aim for no one was injur-
ed.

（批：File 26/1）

坏地带匪徒
向警察开枪

昨晚午夜前夕，西区匪帮活动区域的枪声再次响起，一队中国巡捕成为不明刺客子弹的目标。这些人在顿辛路（Tunsin Road）进行例行巡逻时，突然的火光和枪声打破了夜空。警察拔出手枪占据位置，准备应对任何可能的进一步射击，但向小巷瞥去发现一名男子的身影正逃往市政道路以外的区域。警方未开枪，经检查小队人员，发现隐藏的射手瞄准技术拙劣，无人受伤。

CHINA PRESS.

JAN 26 1930

Hold-Up Men
Wound Russian
Woman Here

Bandits Open Fire On
Police Constables In
Western Area

Gunfire from gangsters' pistols again disturbed Shanghai's tranquility Tuesday night, when Chinese police constables in the western district escaped unscathed while a Russian woman on Brenan Road was shot through her left side.

The constables were patrolling their beats on Tuenin Road when they heard a pistol shot whistle passed their ears. Taking due precautions the police drew their guns and prepared for eventualities.

Realizing the officers had the upper hand, the bandits, who fired from a nearby alleyway, fled in great haste toward the territory off the Settlement Road. No shot was fired by the police and no arrest made.

The wounded Russian woman, Mrs. T. Okladnikova, of 238 Joffre Terrace, was walking along Brenan Road near Warren Road with a companion when they were held up by three armed robbers. Scared by Mrs. Okladnikova's screaming, one of the bandits opened fire. The victim was reported yesterday to be in a critical condition.

Early yesterday evening, three marauders broke into a building at 419 Canton Road and stole $100 from the premises. No shots were fired and no arrests made.

Another robbery was staged in the gangland section of the western district yesterday when four men forcibly entered the house at 671 Changping Road and stole $60.

《大美晚报》。

1930年1月26日

劫匪在此
击伤俄国女子

匪徒在西区
向巡捕开枪

周二晚，匪徒手枪的枪声再次扰乱了上海的宁静，当时西区的中国巡捕毫发无伤地躲过一劫，而布伦南路的一名俄国女子左身中弹。

巡捕在顿宁路（Tuenin Road）巡逻辖区时，听到一声手枪子弹呼啸着擦耳而过。警方采取适当预防措施，拔出手枪并为突发情况做好准备。

意识到警官占据上风，从附近小巷开枪的匪徒匆忙逃往租界道路以外的区域。警方未开枪，也未实施逮捕。

受伤的俄国女子奥克拉德尼科娃夫人（Mrs. T. Okladnikova），住茹科夫台路238号，当时正与一名同伴在华伦路附近的布伦南路行走，遭到三名武装劫匪拦截。奥克拉德尼科娃夫人的尖叫声吓坏了其中一名匪徒，随即开火。据报道，受害者昨日情况危急。

昨日傍晚早些时候，三名掠夺者闯入广东路419号的一栋建筑，从屋内盗走100美元。未发生枪战，也未实施逮捕。

昨日，在西区匪帮活动区又发生了一起抢劫案，四人强行闯入昌平路671号的房屋，盗走60美元。

page_data.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

JAN 26 1939

Tuesday's Outrage

The prophecy made in these columns a short
while ago that if conditions were allowed to
continue in the western outside area as they
have been for some time past, it would not be
long before some foreigners received injury has
been justified all too quickly, as witness the
armed robbery on Tuesday night, when a
Russian lady and companion were held up, and
she shot through the body. This occurred on
Brennan Road near Warren Road. The robbers
got clear away, and though search is being made
for them it is unlikely that this will achieve much
success. Obviously the remedy is a preventive
one, and it is incumbent upon the Ta Tao au-
thorities exercising jurisdiction in that area to
take such steps as to put an end to the dis-
orderly state which at present prevails. Condi-
tions which are permitted to exist within the
defence perimeter, but outside the limits of the
International Settlement, are a standing dis-
grace, and reflect no credit whatever upon the
authorities who are responsible for maintaining
law and order within their jurisdiction.
Obviously so long as the present state of affairs
is allowed to exist it is positively dangerous to
take a walk at night on these roads, a right
which belongs to all law-abiding citizens. The
fact is that the allowing of the various illicit
gambling dens to operate in that area has
transformed it into a veritable Alsatia, with
all manner of armed rogues warring with each
other, and preying upon the peaceful members
of the community. If it is suggested for one
moment that the Ta Tao Government is un-
able to maintain law and order, it is permis-
sible to enquire of what it is capable, for that
is its very first duty. With two armed rob-
beries perpetrated upon foreigners, and one
woman shot has been adduced evidence to
show that absolutely intolerable conditions
exist, and it is really the business of the Ta
Tao Government to vindicate its authority and
put an end to a state of affairs which ought
never to have been allowed to come into
existence.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，

1939年1月26日

周二的暴行

本报栏目不久前曾预言，如果西部越界筑路地区的状况像过去一段时间那样持续下去，不久就会有外国人受伤。这一预言很快就得到了证实，周二晚发生的武装抢劫案即为明证，当时一位俄国女士及其同伴被拦截，她身体中弹。此事发生在华伦路附近的布伦南路（Brennan Road）。劫匪顺利逃脱，尽管正在搜捕他们，但不太可能取得多大成功。显然，补救措施在于预防，在该地区行使管辖权的“大陶”当局有责任采取步骤，结束目前 prevailing 的混乱状态。允许在防御 perimeter 内但在国际租界界限外存在的状况是一种持续的耻辱，丝毫不能为负责在其辖区内维持法律和秩序的当局增光。显然，只要允许目前的局势存在，夜间在这些道路上散步——这是所有守法公民的权利——就确实充满危险。事实是，允许各种非法赌博窝点在该地区运营，已将其变成了一个真正的阿尔萨蒂亚（Alsatia，意为法外之地），各类武装流氓互相争斗，并侵害社区的和平成员。如果有人暗示“大陶”政府无法维持法律和秩序，那么可以质问它究竟有能力做什么，因为那是它的首要职责。发生了两起针对外国人的武装抢劫案，且有一名妇女中弹，这些证据表明存在绝对不可容忍的状况，这确实是“大陶”政府维护其权威并终结本不该允许存在的局势的责任所在。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS
JAN 22 1939

Italian Marine
Patrols Clash
With Gangsters

Man With Gun Nabbed
After Shooting On
Jessfield Road

ONE WOUNDED IN
SECOND INCIDENT

Armed Robber Suspects
Face Local Chinese
Tribunal

Italian marines crashed the local news spotlight again yesterday when they encountered alleged gangsters on two different occasions in the western districts. Shooting by the marines featured both incidents.

The first clash between the Italians and gangster suspects occurred shortly after 2 p.m. A marine patrol and a Chinese police constable of the S.M.P. spotted two suspicious looking individuals near a telephone box on Jessfield Road. Without asking questions, the patrol challenged the two men and found themselves with an argument on their hands. Both gangster suspects broke into a run whereupon the marines started shooting and fired three shots.

Although not wounded, one of the fleeing men stumbled and fell. He was nabbed in a few seconds and an automatic pistol was found in his possession. The other man escaped, apparently unharmed. The arrested man, however, was brought before the First Special District Court yesterday and charged with illegal possession of firearms. His case was remanded until next week.

The second clash between Italian marines and bandit suspects happened about 3 a.m. Jessfield Road near Brenan Place was the scene. Under no illusions concerning the danger threatening foreign patrols in this particular district, the marines challenged all suspicious looking individuals on the street.

On one occasion, they observed a Chinese running down an alleyway. The marines ordered him to stop but the fellow allegedly only increased his speed.

The Italians opened fire and the Chinese disappeared. Reinforcements arrived later and a search of the alley was made but no trace of the man was to be found.

About three hours later, a Chinese wounded in the buttock appeared at the Bubbling Well Police Station and asked to be taken to a hospital. His request was complied but he is now the subject of a police investigation since it is believed that he is the same person wounded by the marines.

**Thugs In Court**

In addition to providing headlines from the western district, Shanghai gangsters also featured activities in the First Special District Court yesterday morning.

Four of 16 armed robber suspects, nabbed by West Hongkew detectives last week on charges of being concerned with the holdup of occupants of the Tien Jao Lodging House, 60 North Honan Road, on Christmas Eve, were given a chance to tell the judge all about it.

They admitted the theft but thought that they should be treated with leniency since they had only robbed a gambling game in progress in one of the hotel rooms. The case was remanded until next week for judgment.

**Loafers Jailed**

Convicted of having stolen four tons of scrap iron from a deserted factory in Hongkew, four Kompo loafers were each given six months in jail by the court yesterday morning.

Using a truck, the loafers allegedly stole the scrap iron early Friday morning. They were arrested as they attempted to leave the factory premises.

《字林西报》
1939年1月22日

意大利海军陆战队
与歹徒发生冲突

杰斯菲尔德路枪击案后
持枪男子被捕

第二起事件中
一人受伤

武装抢劫嫌疑人
面临华界地方法院审判

昨日，意大利海军陆战队在西区两度遭遇疑似歹徒，再次成为本地新闻焦点。这两起事件均涉及海军陆战队开枪射击。

意大利人与涉嫌歹徒之间的第一次冲突发生在下午2点过后不久。一支海军陆战队巡逻队与一名公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的中国巡捕在杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road）的一个电话亭附近发现了两名形迹可疑的人。巡逻队未加询问便上前盘查这两名男子，随即发生了争执。两名涉嫌歹徒拔腿就跑，海军陆战队队员随即开枪，共发射三发子弹。

虽然并未受伤，但其中一名逃跑的男子绊倒摔在地上。他在几秒钟内被抓获，并在其身上搜出一支自动手枪。另一名男子逃脱，显然未受伤害。然而，这名被捕男子昨日被提审至第一特区法院，被控非法持有枪支。案件已延期至下周审理。

意大利海军陆战队与匪徒嫌疑人之间的第二次冲突发生在凌晨3点左右。事发地点位于杰斯菲尔德路靠近布伦南里（Brenan Place）处。鉴于对该特定区域外国巡逻队所面临的危险心知肚明，海军陆战队队员对街上所有形迹可疑的人员进行了盘查。

有一次，他们观察到一名中国人正沿着一条弄堂奔跑。海军陆战队队员命令其站住，但该人据称反而加快了速度。

意大利人开火射击，该中国人随即消失。增援部队随后赶到，并对弄堂进行了搜查，但未发现该人的踪迹。

大约三小时后，一名臀部中弹的中国人出现在静安寺巡捕房，要求被送往医院。他的请求得到了满足，但他现在已成为警方调查的对象，因为人们相信他就是被海军陆战队打伤的那同一个人。

**流氓出庭**

除了提供西区的头条新闻外，上海歹徒昨日上午也在第一特区法院上演了一出戏。

上周，虹口西部侦探逮捕了16名武装抢劫嫌疑人，指控他们参与了对河南北路60号天娇旅馆（Tien Jao Lodging House）住客在平安夜实施的抢劫。其中四名嫌疑人获得了向法官陈述案情的机会。

他们承认了盗窃行为，但认为应从轻发落，因为他们只是抢劫了酒店一个房间内正在进行的赌局。案件已延期至下周宣判。

**流浪汉入狱**

昨日上午，法院判处四名孔波（Kompo，音译）流浪汉各六个月监禁，罪名是从虹口一家废弃工厂偷窃四吨废铁。

据称，这些流浪汉在周五清晨使用一辆卡车偷走了废铁。他们在试图离开工厂厂区时被捕。
